_purpose: Live pages captured as ground truth for template work. Run: npm run capture:live
_notes: URLs were verified against the live site on 2026-09-11, not taken from the original checklist. Three of its URLs were wrong: /en/properties/residential-for-sale/ 404s, /en/mobile-phones-tablets/mobile-phones/ redirect-loops to /en/notfound, and 'Motors landing' repeated the cars-listing URL — the real landing is /en/motors/.
Filters were confirmed to actually apply by comparing ad counts (base 12,854; new_used_eq_1 2,431; new_used_eq_2 10,422; cairo 7,465; cairo + price 2,696).
property-villas replaces the checklist's 'property-apartments': the base property listing is already the apartments category, so a second type is the informative filter state.
Ad pages expire. If a DPV capture 404s, pick a fresh /en/ad/ link from the matching listing page and update it here.

Tier 'templates' fills page templates that had no capture: 'login' is the home page with the Login or Signup dialog opened (login has no route of its own); 'not-found' is expected to return HTTP 404; 'seller-page' is a business profile (/en/companies/…).

Tier 3 (2026-09-16) closes the vertical gaps found by auditing the live navigation: the Property vertical landing is /en/realestate/ (the nav's Property link) — /en/properties/, captured as 'property', is the all-property listing, the counterpart of /en/vehicles/. New Cars (catalogue / brand / model / compare) and Electric Cars are separate Motors surfaces; rent, commercial, vacation homes, land, compound and area pages are the Property listing variants. See docs/PAGE-COVERAGE.md.
